chunks: Hearts are naturally inclined to love those who do good to them and to dislike those who harm them.

key_terms.أَحْسَنَ إِلَيْهَا: did good to them and treated them with beneficence
key_terms.أَسَاءَ إِلَيْهَا: did evil to them or treated them badly
key_terms.جُبِلَتِ الْقُلُوبُ: Hearts have been fashioned with an innate disposition

ai.seo_question: Why do people naturally love those who treat them well and dislike those who harm them?
ai.summary: This hadith states a basic truth about human nature: hearts are disposed to love beneficence and to resent harm. It highlights an ethical principle in social conduct, showing how kindness nurtures affection while mistreatment produces aversion.
